summaryZh: Neuro D-Tox Lab 研究物质使用相关的生物标志物、认知、行为与心理健康变化，并利用纵向毒理资料研究使用的预测因素和结果。项目结合生物样本、毛发毒理、手机问卷和被动感知等资料。
researchQuestions: 戒断期间生物标志物的变化如何关联认知、行为和心理健康？
纵向毒理指标如何关联物质使用的预测因素与结果？
topics: 物质使用纵向预测与结果

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Neuro D-Tox Lab!
Wade Lab - Neuro D-Tox Lab Website → https://wade-lab.ucsd.edu/
We're following young adults for 6 weeks, measuring different behaviors and biosamples with weekly visi ts and daily phone surveys .

The project aims to better understand how changes in objective biological markers, including cannabinoids and the body’s natural endocannabinoid system, relate to improvements in cognition, behavior, and mental health throughout abstinence.

Our lab has received independent funding from NIDA (K08 DA050779) and the California Department of Cannabis Control to investigate longitudinal predictors and outcomes related to substance use as measured through hair toxicology.
ABCD domains commonly studied in the lab: Substance use self-report Hair toxicology Neurocognition and neuroimaging Passive sensing of smartphone use (EARS)
Dr. Wade serves as a Co-Investigator on the NCANDA-A UC San Diego data collection site.
Welcome to the Neuro D-Tox, or Neuropsychology, Development, and Toxicology Lab at UC San Diego!
